title: Omens of the Waning
author: Watcher Caelvas Saevaris
pages: A list for reeves and lords, so you know what the Watchers see and do not call us mad until you have checked. These signs mean the binding is thinning. They do not mean you are doomed. Yet.
One: falling stars on clear nights, many, from one point in the sky. Two: the Tall Ones seen more often and nearer to towns. Three: children dreaming of a door with no light behind it.
Four: grey ear in fields that were clean last year. Five: hush-moss in mines where there was none. Six: quiet strangers feeding the hungry and asking nothing. Report all six to your Flamekeeper.
What to do: tend the graves. Feed your poor before someone else does. Sleep at night. Keep stores. And if anyone proposes a grand expedition to slay the Hollow Wyrm, invite a Watcher to dinner first.
